checked.item: "Invoice date" label and options "Created date" / "Issued date": neither option is marked as recommended, but Payment posting date marks one

"The date Synder puts on Stripe invoices in your books: when the invoice was created, or when it was issued to your customer. Applies to invoices synced from now on.": plain, and it reassures that past invoices stay as they are

"Locked while Revenue Recognition starts schedules from the invoice date. To change it, change Schedule start date.": uses "Revenue Recognition" and "schedules", and "the invoice date" matches the name of the locked setting
"Upgrade to use" chip and "This feature is available on higher plans. Upgrade plan": declined pattern, not re-flagged
"Payment posting date" label: "posting" is accountant wording
"Balance date (recommended)" and "other Stripe balance transactions": "balance" is explained by "when the money reaches your Stripe balance"
"Invoices follow the Invoice date setting on the Invoices tab.": a clear pointer
"Issued date" and "Date in books" rows: "Jan 6, 2026 · issued date, per Invoice date setting" is clear
"Date in books" row is missing, so only "Transaction date" and "Issued date" show; nothing says which one went to the books
"Sales recording date" options "Invoice created date" / "Invoice issued date" / "Payment date"
"With Payment date there is no Accounts Receivable in summaries.": the jargon leaves the result of this choice unclear
Saves on change with no Update button and no success message
"Schedule start date" options: "Invoice created date", "Invoice issued date", "Payment date"

"Change schedule start date?" plus "Existing schedules keep their current dates until they’re rebuilt — contact support to rebuild them.": reassuring; "rebuilt" may worry some users; Cancel/Change are clear
New "Invoice issued date" column is blank for older rows; not on screen in the product

findings.element: Invoices tab → Invoice date → lock note (RevRec org, Schedule start = Invoice created date)
findings.finding: The note blames "Revenue Recognition" and "the invoice date", but the setting it locks is itself called Invoice date and the RevRec option is now called Invoice created date, so the explanation reads as "Invoice date is locked by the invoice date".
findings.user_impact: A first-timer can't tell what is locking the field or whether they broke something, and may leave instead of following the Schedule start date link.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the product and the exact option: "Locked because Synder RevRec starts schedules from the invoice created date. To change it, change Schedule start date."

evidence.quote: Locked while Revenue Recognition starts schedules from the invoice date. To change it, change Schedule start date.
evidence.source: vocabulary.md › Synder Product Names: "Synder RevRec"; context.md product fact: RevRec "Invoice date" is renamed to "Invoice created date"

findings.element: Sales tab → renamed "Payment posting date" label
findings.finding: "Posting" is accountant wording that Synder's vocabulary replaces with "Sync", and a non-accountant reads "Payment posting date" as just another invoice or payment date with no clear difference from Invoice date.
findings.user_impact: The user hesitates over which of the 2 date settings controls what they see in their books, and may change the wrong one.
findings.suggested_fix: Match the "Date in books" wording used in Sync details, for example "Payment date in books".

evidence.source: vocabulary.md › UI Words — Canonical Terms: "Sync (Synchronization) | post, push (syncing data from Synder to books)"

findings.element: Summary settings → Sales recording date card description
findings.finding: The only consequence the card mentions is "no Accounts Receivable in summaries", and a business owner doesn't know what Accounts Receivable is or whether losing it is bad.
findings.user_impact: The user either avoids Payment date out of fear or picks it without knowing that unpaid sales stop appearing as money owed to them.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the term and explain it in plain words, for example "With Payment date there is no Accounts Receivable (money customers still owe you) in summaries."

evidence.quote: With Payment date there is no Accounts Receivable in summaries.
evidence.source: plain-language (Account Names: "Accounts Receivable" is the required term, so it needs an explanation, not a new name)

gaps: Invoices lock note: only the Schedule start = Invoice created date state was captured. The note text when Schedule start = Invoice issued date was never recorded, so it's unknown whether "the invoice date" wording also appears there.
Learn more / Learn more → links (Invoice date, Payment posting date, Sales recording date): href="#", so the explanation a confused user would rely on can't be judged.

Reassurance after saving: Update on the Stripe tabs, Summary save-on-change and the RevRec Change button all show no success message. Whether production shows a toast here ("Settings updated!") isn't recorded, so the missing confirmation can't be confirmed as a defect.

Sync details example B (synced on created date): the "Date in books" row disappears, so only "Transaction date" and "Issued date" show. It wasn't checked whether anything else on that screen tells the user which date went to the books.
